name: frontend-flow

plugins.name: frontend-flow
plugins.description: Token-efficient, multi-phase frontend design workflow. Picks the system architecture that fits your requirement, resolves a reference site by name or URL, extracts real design tokens instead of guessing, reads the design system already present in your codebase, asks a couple of quick preference questions, then builds — keeping the noisy extraction inside subagents that exit, so the main context carries the judgment and not the markup.

description: Frontend and architecture workflow for Claude Code: pick the system architecture a requirement actually justifies, extract the design system a codebase really has, and build against measured tokens instead of guessed ones.
